items.headline: Trelain Maddox's late TD, Duke missed FG gives Yellow Jackets first ACC win of season.
items.description: — Trelain Maddox rushed for 81 yards and three touchdowns, including a go-ahead score from one yard out with 54 seconds remaining, leading Georgia Tech to a 28-25 upset victory over Duke at Bobby Dodd Stadium on Saturday.
